summary_md: **Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition Papers ([@CSVisionPapers](https://x.com/CSVisionPapers/status/2116595219550339535))** shares *Multi-Agent Relay Thinking* by Liu et al. ([arXiv 2610.35219](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35219)), whose **MACR** framework passes reasoning ownership between agents based on confidence so later agents refine an evolving trajectory.

media.description: Abstract of the Multi-Agent Relay Thinking paper introducing confidence-guided relay (MACR).
media.ocr_text: Existing multi-agent collaboration (MAC) methods have primarily explored a group thinking collaboration topology, where agents independently generate solutions and aggregate their outputs. In this work, we investigate an alternative relay thinking topology, where reasoning ownership is dynamically transferred across agents, allowing subsequent agents to inherit and refine an evolving reasoning trajectory. We introduce Multi-Agent Confidence-guided Relay (MACR), a framework that enables dynamical relay collaboration among agents. The key challenge is determining when reasoning should be relayed and which agent should continue the process. method addresses this challenge through confidence-guided relay triggering and a bidding mechanism that selects the next agent based on its confidence.
